text:
maria: heads up — started seeing a big spike in route-level queueing for /invoke-tool this morning. correlates with a jump in validator.rejects for adapter-v2 :eyes:
aj: saw that too. graphs show rejection rate up from 0.2% -> 6% in 15m, and the route hit soft-quota backpressure, so requests are getting routed to fallback model and some are getting 429s
ethan: any common pattern in the rejects? model vs adapter vs specific tool schemas?
maria: quick grep of logs shows most rejects flagged as HARD_SCHEMA_MISMATCH from the tool adapter. sample payload in logs:
```json
{
  "tool": "price_lookup",
  "response": {
    "price": "$12.99", // expected number not string
    "currency": "USD"
  }
}
```
aj: that example is classic. validator expects {price: number, currency: string}. adapter-v2 introduced permissive coercions but validator got stricter in last rollout. mismatch between adapter decisions and platform schema policies
console-sig: UI impact — the console currently surfaces generic "tool rejects" but not the rejection type or adapter version. PMs getting tickets complaining about 429 spikes and no drilldown
maria: immediate mitigation suggestion: flip route to soft-validate for canary slices and add a temporary rule to coerce numeric strings for price-like fields at adapter layer. canary then watch quality eval set
ethan: operationally we should also emit more granular telemetry now: validator.rejection_count{type=hard|soft, adapter=adapter-v2, route=/invoke-tool, model=redwood-004} and a histogram of reject_latency. Without adapter tag it's impossible to correlate rollouts
aj: agreed. and console needs a dashboard tile that breaks down rejects by (type, adapter, route) and links to sampled log id for quick bisection
console-sig: can add a new panel in "Tooling -> Validation" that surfaces top 10 reject signatures, and a filter for adapter version. I'll scope a small PR to add the panel and a drilldown link to shared logs
maria: in the short term, can we toggle a deploy flag to revert validator strictness? deploy-bot: rolled back validator-config v3 -> v2 for routes: /invoke-tool (slice: default) at 11:42am — impact should be visible in ~30s
ethan: rollback acknowledged. followups: 1) better release gating (canary-autolevel for validator config) 2) metrics + labels for reject reasons 3) console UX for drilldown 4) a documented emergency soft-validate toggle
aj: also recommend adding automatic fallback routing policy: if reject_rate > 3% AND adapter_version changed within 1h then enable soft-validate for 5m and notify on-call with sampled examples
maria: i'll file the followup RFC with the telemetry fields we need and a quick runbook for oncall. will include a sample KQL query and the alerting thresholds
ethan: for RFC include concrete metric names and retention (validator.rejection_count, validator.sampled_example_id, validator.rejection_rate_1m). retention 90d for counts, 7d for sampled bodies
console-sig: PR incoming for dashboard this afternoon, will @maria when it's staged
aj: thanks. once dashboards + metrics are up we'll re-enable stricter validation behind canary with the new observability knobs
maria: thanks all :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: alert created: #inc-224567 — high tool-reject spike; on-call: aj
